description: This file defines extension methods for grains in Orleans that are implicitly subscribed to streams, specifically providing a method to get the stream identity from a grain with a GUID compound key.

classes.name: ImplicitConsumerGrainExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for grains implicitly subscribed to streams.

methods.name: GetImplicitStreamIdentity
methods.description: Constructs a StreamIdentity object representing the stream the grain is implicitly subscribed to, based on the grain's primary key.
